mechanism: Percentile-ranked Band 8 dilatation field defines low/mid/high terciles; the 5,648 lowest-dilatation parent dots are relocated (exact expected marginal DTI refill) into high-dilatation tercile cells on valid, off-catalogue (d_cat > 2.0 px) H19-5 support; unit mass and count held. Pure array math; the catalogue is used only for masking/clearance, never to build features.
